name: Tachibana Suzuo
source:
A first-year student at Nanyo Private High School in Nobetsu. A member of the broadcasting club.

He has the face of a timid boy and a personality that rarely asserts itself.

For some reason, he joined the broadcasting club and is teased by the strong-willed Michiaki and Kotaro, and is often at the mercy of Wakana.

He always wears an ambiguous smile and has the special ability to express all his emotions with a smile.

[Translated from the [url=http://hanpamania-soft.com/HMS001-fuyugami/fuyugami_chara_suzuo.html]official website[/url]]
